keyEvents.text: Artemijus Tutyskinas (Celje) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Sturm Graz 0, Celje 1. Svit Seslar (Celje) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the centre of the goal.
Goal! Sturm Graz 1, Celje 1. Oumar Diakité (Sturm Graz) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the top right corner.
Delay in match because of an injury Artemijus Tutyskinas (Celje).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Goal! Sturm Graz 1, Celje 2. Benjamin Verbic (Celje) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the top right corner. Assisted by Milot Avdyli.
First Half ends, Sturm Graz 1, Celje 2.
Delay in match because of an injury Papa Daniel (Celje).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, Celje. Mario Kvesic replaces Benjamin Verbic.
Substitution, Celje. Zan Zuzek replaces Papa Daniel.
Substitution, Sturm Graz. Jacob Hödl replaces Valmir Matoshi.
Substitution, Celje. Blaz Kramer replaces Veton Tusha.
Oumar Diakité (Sturm Graz) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Sturm Graz 1, Celje 3. Svit Seslar (Celje) left footed shot from very close range to the bottom left corner.
Substitution, Sturm Graz. Belmin Beganovic replaces Arjan Malic.
Substitution, Celje. Darko Hrka replaces Armandas Kucys.
Substitution, Sturm Graz. Gizo Mamageishvili replaces Simon Seidl.
Milot Avdyli (Celje) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.

Goal! Sturm Graz 2, Celje 3. Oumar Diakité (Sturm Graz) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Gizo Mamageishvili with a cross following a set piece situation.
